news.title: ESAG publishes sector action plans for UK international education strategy
news.summary_en: The UK’s Education Sector Advisory Group (ESAG) has published a series of sector action plans setting out proposed activity to support the delivery of the UK’s international education strategy through to 2030.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Ireland looks overseas as minister questions international student model
news.summary_en: Ireland's higher education minister James Lawless has urged greater focus on teaching abroad as housing and capacity pressures test further growth in Ireland’s inbound international student market.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: ‘A massive punch in the face’: Students pay the price for ILAC’s sudden collapse
news.summary_en: Current and incoming ILAC students and their families tell The PIE of tuition at risk, cancelled travel and immigration uncertainty, as language learners receive replacement classes while career-college students await answers.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Irish uni chairs seek €190m as funding pressures mount
news.summary_en: Six governing body leaders say rising costs and student numbers have left the sector more than €250 million short each year.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: The verification gap: can we still measure what matters?
news.summary_en: Skills have never been more important than in today's job market. But how can employers make sure that today's grads have the tools they need in a quickly changing employment landscape, asks David Harkin.
news.author: David Harkin

news.title: Australia squeezes dependants as wider student migration questions emerge
news.summary_en: Australia is squeezing access to dependant visas as the government moves to reduce net overseas migration, with wider questions emerging over its student migration settings and 295,000 student intake target.
news.author: Kim Martin
